title: TAM: Torque Adaptation Module for Robust Motion Transfer in Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2606.06218v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A policy tuned for one robot often behaves differently on another, whether due to the sim-to-real gap, unknown payloads, or the differing dynamics of two instances of the same robot. In contact-rich, dynamic manipulation, even small motion discrepancies can result in failure to track reference motion, since they disrupt the timing and modes of contact. Common remedies, such as domain randomization or system identification, either produce overly conservative task policies or require data that must be recollected for each robot or payload. We introduce the Torque Adaptation Module (TAM), a learned module that adapts the torque commands sent to the robot to match the behavior of an ideal robot. TAM operates between the low-level controller that tracks the policy's actions and the robot's torque interface. translated_title: TAM：用于机械臂操作中鲁棒运动传递的扭矩自适应模块
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.06218v2 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：为某一台机器人调优的策略在另一台机器人上往往表现不同，其原因可能来自仿真到现实的差距、未知负载，或同一型号两台机器人之间不同的动力学特性。在接触丰富、动态的操作任务中，即使微小的运动差异也可能导致无法跟踪参考运动，因为这些差异会破坏接触的时机与模式。常见的解决方案，如域随机化或系统辨识，要么产生过于保守的任务策略，要么需要针对每台机器人或每种负载重新采集的数据。我们提出了扭矩自适应模块（TAM），这是一个通过学习得到的模块，它对发送给机器人的扭矩指令进行调整，使机器人的行为与理想机器人相匹配。TAM 工作在跟踪策略动作的底层控制器与机器人扭矩接口之间，包含一个将本体感知历史嵌入潜在状态的历史编码器，以及一个计算残余扭矩的扭矩适配器……
tldr: TAM 是一个位于底层控制器与扭矩接口之间的学习模块，通过基于本体感知历史自适应地调整扭矩指令，使操作策略在跨机器人、跨负载和仿真到现实迁移中仍能鲁棒地跟踪参考运动。
en_tdlr: TAM is a learned module that sits between the low-level controller and the robot's torque interface, adaptively adjusting torque commands based on proprioceptive history to enable robust reference motion tracking across sim-to-real gaps, unknown payloads, and different robot instances.
